programme.title: Andrea Molteni - Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. He has performed at the Wiener Saal of the Mozarteum University in Salzburg, Scriabin Museum in Moscow, National Opera Center in New York, and several other international venues. This performance was recorded at the Oberlin Conservatory of Music, Ohio, USA, in 2022.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti - Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach. On the program is a selection of Preludes and Fugues from Bach’s The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II: No. 9 in E major, No. 14 in F-sharp minor, No. 15 in G major, No. 20 in A minor, No. 2 in C minor, No. 1 in C major, No. 4 in C-sharp minor, No. 6 in D minor, No. 7 in E-flat major, No. 8 in D-sharp minor, and No. 13 in F-sharp major. Bacchetti closes the recital with Bach’s Aria variata alla maniera italiana in A minor, BWV 989. This performance was recorded at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy, on December 9, 2022.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Leonardo García Alarcón - B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. On the program: Strozzi’s Sino alla morte. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices
programme.desc: The story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Andrea Molteni - Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. He has appeared at the Wiener Saal of the Mozarteum University in Salzburg, Scriabin Museum in Moscow, National Opera Center in New York, and several other international venues. This performance was recorded at the Verbrugghen Hall of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music, Australia, in 2023.

programme.title: Myung-whun Chung And Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino - Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called ‘curse of the ninth,’ did not want to write a Symphony No. 9. After all, fellow composers Ludwig van Beethoven and Anton Bruckner died before writing their tenth symphonies. Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 premiered on June 26, 1912, in Vienna, performed by the Vienna Philharmonic led by Bruno Walter. Unfortunately, the composer himself did not live to see this: he died in 1911. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janáček, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janáček’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on May 11, 2024.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugène Ysaÿe, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland And Hartmut Haenchen - Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The German-born conductor, who became a Dutch citizen through naturalisation, was chief conductor at the Dutch National Opera, the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra, and the Netherlands Chamber Orchestra before he was finally knighted for his services to the Dutch music landscape. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner. Bruckner's use of Wagner tubas and double bass tubas creates an even more solemn and grandiose air within the Adagio. Trumpet signals refer to crowing cockerels as they interrupt the grim and clamorous Scherzo. In the Finale, Bruckner employs a persistent rhythmic pulse that starts softly yet builds up towards the explosive final bars.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's Resurrection Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale. The symphony features immense orchestral forces, including offstage brass and a large choir, which combine to create overwhelming sonic experiences that depict profound spiritual and emotional narratives. The grand scale and dramatic structure represent the triumph of life over death.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería And José Areán - Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Boris Berezovsky, Alexander Sladkovsky And Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra - Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986). This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovksy Concert Hall of the Moscow Philharmonic Society on April 28, 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle And London Symphony Orchestra - Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Lukáš Vondráček, Michael Tilson Thomas And London Symphony Orchestra - Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondráček as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 6 in B-flat major, BWV 1051. Contrary to the other five concertos, this piece does not include violins, instead offering the floor to the lower strings and the harpsichord.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a March 2023 concert featuring Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G with soloist Víkingur Ólafsson, and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition orchestrated by Ravel.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvořák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, From the New World. Composed during Dvořák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuid in a performance of Richard Danielpour's Elegies. Soloists are Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone). Recorded at Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands, 2019.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations. The theme had been composed by Baron von Fricken, an amateur musician and father of Ernestine von Fricken, to whom Schumann was engaged in 1834. The work was first published in 1837, containing the theme and twelve etudes (only nine of them were indicated ‘variations’). Fifteen years later, in 1852, Schumann published a second edition of the work, eliminating two etudes and making some revisions to the piano writing. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer - The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor. In that very same church the thirty-fourth ‘Thomaskantor’, Gotthold Schwarz, leads the St. Thomas Boys Choir Leipzig and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig in a performance of Bach’s choral masterpiece. Among the soloists are Dorothee Mields (soprano), Elvira Bill (alto), Patrick Grahl (tenor, Evangelist), Markus Schäfer (tenor, arias), and Klaus Häger (bass). This performance was recorded in 2018.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a Concerto for piano without orchestra, in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles. In 1853, Schumann revised the work and added a Scherzo as a second movement. The final movement is reminiscent of Schumann’s earlier composition Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz presents Robert Schumann's 'Novelletten, Op. 21', an eight-piece solo piano cycle composed in 1838 and dedicated to pianist Adolph Henselt, whose individual movements are often performed separately.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Bolero by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as “an infinity of contrast”, “a setting of the small world beside the great”, and where “a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness”. Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Kirill Karabits And Lucy Crowe - Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty. With soprano Lucy Crowe lending her vocal radiance to this extraordinary finale, the symphony’s journey to bliss is complete. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on December 8, 2021.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Renowned Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen reflects on his life, artistic vision, and celebrated career. Friends and colleagues share insights alongside excerpts from his groundbreaking ballets.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer’s unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist’s beloved, an ‘idée fixe’ (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece. Together with his septet and First Symphony, this piano concerto was finally performed at his official Vienna debut on April 2, 1800 at the Hofburg theatre, with Beethoven himself at the piano. The composer had long ceased to be an unknown in Austria’s capital: he had been playing private concerts all around town for years.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería And José Areán - Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Galaxymphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan’s performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra And Lasse Mauritzen - Luisi conducts Strauss, Beethoven And Schoenberg
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Strauss’ Horn Concerto No. 1. This work is one of the most popular and frequently performed horn concertos written in the 19th century, and the first orchestral piece the composer wrote for the instrument. Strauss’ father, Franz, was a virtuoso horn player, and one of the leading performers of his time. Also featured in this program are performances of Beethoven’s immortal Symphony No. 7 and Schoenberg’s early work Verklärte Nacht. The soloist for Strauss’ virtuoso Horn Concerto is the DNSO’s principal horn player Lasse Mauritzen. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Tim Weiss - Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: This documentary follows the recording of Philip Glass's composition A Descent into the Maelström in Norway's Lofoten Islands and features a rare interview with the composer.

programme.title: Fryderyk Chopin - The Piano Concertos
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the awakening of nature to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin And Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra - Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: Mendelssohn, Grieg, Beethoven - Flanders Symphony Orchestra, Jan Latham-Koenig: Mendelssohn, Grieg, Beethoven
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Mendelssohn’s Die Hebriden, Grieg’s Piano Concerto, and Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Davidsbündlertänze (Dances of the League of David), Op. 6, is a group of eighteen pieces for piano composed in 1837, named after Schumann's fictional music society Davidsbündler. In these, the active and the passive aspects of Schumann’s personality, represented by the characters Florestan and Eusebius, engage in musical dialogues about contemporary music. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 7 in F major, Op. 59, No. 1, known as “Razumovsky”; String Quartet No. 13 in B-flat major, Op. 130; and the monumental Great Fugue, Op. 133. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 12, 2020.

programme.title: Sergei Nakariakov And Maria Meerovitch - Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, trumpetist Sergei Nakariakov and pianist Maria Meerovitch perform Lensky’s aria from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s opera Eugene Onegin.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Conductor Zubin Mehta leads the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra in rehearsals for Richard Strauss's tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, capturing their collaborative musical dialogue.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The customary long introduction is replaced by two powerful chords, followed by the introduction of the main theme by the lower strings. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff’s piano transcription of J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 3 in E major; a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39); Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5); Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7; and Rachmaninoff’s transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti - Bach - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach’s celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach’s masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria’s melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan And Cleveland Orchestra - Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre - La Bayadère
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet’s music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.desc: Sehen: Woozle möchte unbedingt Arzt spielen und Maria als Dr. Dr. Holzauge untersuchen. Doch Maria ist nicht gerade begeistert und dann macht der Superblinzler 3001 sie auch noch durchsichtig.Höhlen: Woozle erzählt Simón von einer verfluchten Höhle in Woozlingen. Die Legende besagt, dass jeder Woozle einmal im Jahr dorthin gehen und Kaiser Woozarosa einen Rasierapparat mitbringen muss. Sonst droht ein böser Fluch!

programme.title: Ein Prinz zu Weihnachten - Verliebt im Winterwunderland
programme.desc: Olivia und Prinz Alexander sind seit sechs Monaten ein Paar. Gemeinsam reisen sie zum Königspalast in Torovia, um dort Weihnachten mit ihren beiden Familien zu verbringen. Trotz eines vollen Terminkalenders, der das Paar in unterschiedliche Richtungen drängt, scheint ein unvergessliches Weihnachtsfest bevorzustehen. Doch zwischen den beiden Familien, die aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen stammen, gibt es immer wieder Reibereien.

programme.title: Mein Weihnachtsprinz
programme.desc: Samantha Logan ist seit einigen Monaten neu verliebt. In Alex, einen europäischen Diplomaten, der in einer Botschaft arbeitet, meint jedenfalls Samantha. Als sie über Weihnachten zu ihren Eltern in ihre Heimatstadt Maple Falls in Wyoming fährt, überrascht Alex sie dort mit seinem Besuch. Das soll aber nicht die einzige Überraschung bleiben: es stellt sich heraus, dass ihr Freund Prinz Alexander von Madelvia ist.

programme.title: Verliebt in meinen Weihnachtsschwarm
programme.desc: Der Anwalt Hugo und seine beste Freundin Madelyn reisen in Hugos Heimatstadt, um das Weihnachtsfest mit Hugos Mutter Kate zu verbringen. Kate hat arrangiert, dass Hugo auf seinen ehemaligen Schwarm Patrick trifft, der vor Kurzem aus dem Silicon Valley hierher zurückgekehrt ist. Während der Feiertage kommen sich die beiden immer näher, und sie bemühen sich außerdem, den vom Abriss bedrohten Bahnhof zu retten.

programme.title: Teleshoppingsendung
programme.desc: Die Folgen zur Serie oder Show findest du bald hier.

programme.title: Milo
programme.desc: Das Mode-Team von Stevie arbeitet an einem besonderen Hauptstück für die Modenschau. Dafür müssen Milo, Lofty und Lark eigene Kreationen entwerfen, anfertigen und auf dem Laufsteg vorführen.

programme.title: Milo
programme.desc: Als sich Milo, Lofty und Lark um Horatios Zahnarztpraxis kümmern, lieben sie es dafür zu sorgen, dass keiner ohne ein strahlendes Lächeln geht. Sogar Herr Krok lernt, dass ein Zahnarztbesuch etwas Gutes ist - vor allem, wenn es Sticker gibt!

programme.title: Milo
programme.desc: Als sich Milo, Lofty und Lark im Kontrollzentrum melden, sind sie bald auf dem Weg zum Mond, um Milas wertvolle Weltraumerdbeeren zu retten. Doch im All gibt es für das Trio viel zu entdecken.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Peppa lebt mit Mama und Papa Wutz und ihrem kleinen Bruder Schorsch in einem kleinen Haus auf einem Hügel. Dort erkundet das neugierige und verspielte Schweinemädchen zusammen mit ihren Freunden die Umgebung - denn überall gibt es etwas zu entdecken!

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Peppas Familie geht mit der Känguru-Familie an den Strand. Die Kängurus sind erfahrene Surfer. Kylie bringt Peppa bei, wie man mit dem Surfbrett umgeht, Schorsch dagegen ist es verboten.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Peppa darf Frau Känguru bei der Arbeit helfen. Sie ist schon ganz aufgeregt, weil Frau Känguru am Great Barrier Reef, dem schönsten Korallenriff, arbeitet.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Zum Abschied bekommt Peppa einen Bumerang von Frau Känguru geschenkt. Aber wie wirft man einen Bumerang, sodass er wieder zum Werfer zurückkommt? Gar nicht so einfach.

programme.title: Weihnachtsmann And Co. KG
programme.desc: Durch eine Zauberuhr kann der Weihnachtsmann überall auf der Welt am gleichen Abend die Geschenke verteilen. Doch dann ändert Grantelbart den Verlauf der Zeit und unsere Helden rasen in die Vergangenheit.

programme.title: Paw Patrol

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Rocky und Rubble verbringen einen entspannten Tag am Strand, während Rocky seine Arbeit als Strandaufsicht erledigt. Rubble baut eine beeindruckende Sandburg und die beiden Freunde genießen die Sonne und das Meer.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: In der 13. Staffel der Paw Patrol begleiten wir die Fellfreunde auf spannende neue Missionen. Ob Luftabenteuer oder dramatische Rettungsaktionen in der Abenteuerbucht - neue Freunde und spannende Rettungseinsätze stehen auf dem Programm.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: In der Spielgruppe darf Peppa heute ihr liebstes Kinderlied vorsingen. Alle Kinder haben so viel Spaß beim Singen, dass sie am Ende selbst tolle Reime für neue Lieder erfinden.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Heute geht es mit der ganzen Familie ins Baggerland. Peppa und Schorsch dürfen einen echten Gabelstapler fahren - natürlich nur in Begleitung mit Mama und Papa Wutz.

programme.title: Peppa Wutz
programme.desc: Peppa und Schorsch finden Papa Wutz'' alten Teddy. Der sieht ganz schön mitgenommen aus, daher bringen sie ihn in eine Puppenklinik. Frau Mümmel hat bestimmt die richtige Medizin für das alte Kuscheltier.

programme.title: Die Baby Lemminge
programme.desc: Die Baby-Lemminge erzeugen eine Melodie mit mitreißendem Rhythmus. Alle tanzen gemeinsam, doch Baby-Biber stolpert über seine eigenen Füße. Wird er es schaffen, trotzdem im Club der coolen Lemming-Tänzer aufgenommen zu werden?

programme.title: Die Baby Lemminge
programme.desc: Die Baby-Lemminge sind begabt darin, mit ihren Zähnen schöne Skulpturen aus Holz zu erschaffen. Baby-Biber kann es zunächst nicht glauben, weiß ihr Talent dann aber für sich zu nutzen.

programme.title: Die Baby Lemminge
programme.desc: Während die Baby-Lemminge mit Haselnüssen spielen, versucht Baby-Streifenhörnchen alle Haselnüsse für seinen Vorrat einzusammeln. Dabei nimmt es den Lemmingen sogar ihre Spiel-Nüsse weg. Ein Konkurrenzkampf um die Nüsse entbrennt und endet im Chaos.

programme.title: BABY born
programme.desc: Emma bekommt zu ihrem Geburtstag eine Schiebe-Berta. Gemeinsam mit ihren Freund:innen und mit Teddys Hilfe reisen sie in die Fantasiewelt. Dort fahren sie auf ihren eigenen, rollenden Bertas um die Wette und entdecken viele neue Dinge.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dad plant ein Quesadilla-Picknick, aber er hat die notwendigen Zutaten vergessen. Dora beschließt, ihm zu helfen und macht sich auf den Weg, um die fehlenden Zutaten zu besorgen. Sie übernimmt die Aufgabe, damit das Picknick stattfinden kann.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Boots äußert den Wunsch, größer zu sein, und verwandelt sich daraufhin in ein riesiges Wesen. Dora steht ihm zur Seite und hilft ihm, die Herausforderungen zu meistern, die mit seiner neuen Größe einhergehen. Gemeinsam finden sie einen Weg, Boots wieder auf seine ursprüngliche Größe zu bringen.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie!
programme.desc: Bluster entführt Brummbärchi, um mit seiner schlechten Laune Fiesheit zu säen. Er sperrt ihn in ein Labyrinth und will ihn zur Weißglut bringen.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie!
programme.desc: Plunk wird von Bluster fast verbannt, da er nicht böse genug ist, bekommt aber eine letzte Aufgabe.

programme.title: Rubble And Crew
programme.desc: Gourmet Gabriel plant einen Bananen-Tag und benötigt die Hilfe von Rubble und Crew, um Frieda Funkels Bühne für ihr Konzert zu platzieren. Die Baupfoten versuchen zunächst, die Bühne vor der Auto-Waschanlage und beim Kaninchen-Ball-Golf aufzustellen, doch beide Orte sind ungeeignet. Schließlich findet die Bühne auf dem Dach von Gabriels Geschäft ihren Platz, sodass Frieda ihr Konzert geben kann und der Bananen-Tag gerettet ist.

programme.title: Rubble And Crew
programme.desc: Die Baupfoten freuen sich auf eine Sternenbeobachtung, doch Herr Schnellmeisters Lichtprojektion stört den Himmel und gefährdet Camila auf See. Wheeler kann das Problem nicht lösen, aber Tante Crane installiert einen neuen Scheinwerfer, sodass Camila sicher ankommt und die Hunde den Sternenhimmel genießen können.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Sam vervollständigt ihre Steinsammlung auf einer Marsbasis mit der Hilfe von Jett, Mary und ihren tierischen sowie technischen Begleitern. Die Suche nach dem letzten gelben Stein führt jedoch zu einer gefährlichen Situation, als ein schlafender Vulkankrater durch Bohrungen aktiv wird. Jett und Mary reagieren geistesgegenwärtig und verschließen den Krater mit einem Deckel aus Eis, um die drohende Gefahr abzuwenden.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Jett und Traver liefern Marcia und ihrem Papa einen Fernseher, damit sie ein Fußballspiel sehen können, aber ein Stromausfall in Foz do Iguaçu macht dies unmöglich. Der Generator am Damm der Iguaçu-Fälle hat aufgrund des niedrigen Wasserstandes im See den Betrieb eingestellt. Gemeinsam reisen sie zu den Wasserfällen, ändern die Fließrichtung des Wassers und bringen den Generator wieder in Gang, sodass sie das Spiel zusammen ansehen können.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: In der 13. Staffel der Paw Patrol begleiten wir die Fellfreunde auf spannende neue Missionen. Ob Luftabenteuer oder dramatische Rettungsaktionen in der Abenteuerbucht - neue Freunde und spannende Rettungseinsätze stehen auf dem Programm.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: In Abenteuerbucht sind alle Vögel verschwunden, einschließlich der Goldkehlchen, die normalerweise so schön singen. Ryder und seine Fellfreunde beschließen, die Vögel zu suchen und herauszufinden, was passiert ist.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: Gabby und Pandy müssen Ratkatz auf Katzturn retten. DJ Katzenminze bringt ihnen ein Lied zur Orientierung bei, Baby Box hilft beim Bau von Jetpacks und in der Katzmosphere begegnen sie DJ Komet.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie!
programme.desc: Der magische Pinata-Baum erblüht nur, wenn ein alter Whiffle einmal jährlich lacht.

programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie!
programme.desc: Brummbärchi versucht den Wolkenapparat zu reparieren, doch Dibble macht ständig Quatsch. Nachdem Bluster und Rob entkommen, ist Brummbärchi sauer.

programme.title: Barbie im Doppelpack
programme.desc: Brooklyn und Malibu feiern jeweils an unterschiedlichen Küsten Thanksgiving. Dabei drohen Familienangelegenheiten und Truthahn-Pannen das Fest auf den Kopf zu stellen.

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge
programme.desc: Die Lemminge veranstalten einen Baumstamm-Wurfwettbewerb, der abgebrochen wird, als Grizzy sie in die Ferne verstößt. Die Nager landen auf einer alten keltischen Stätte, wo sie zufällig auf ein magisches Armband stoßen, das die Kraft desjenigen, der es trägt, um das Zehnfache erhöht. Die Lemminge beginnen den Wurfwettbewerb mit ihrer neuen Kraft, nur diesmal mit Hinkelsteinen!

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge
programme.desc: Grizzy und die Lemminge streiten sich um die TV-Fernbedienung. Der Streit führt den Bären während eines Gewitters auf die Spitze des Schlossturms. In einem geheimen Raum erblickt er im Licht eines Blitzes eine menschliche Gestalt. Erschrocken löst Grizzy unwissentlich einen Mechanismus aus, der durch den Blitz aktiviert wurde und eine mittelalterliche Rüstung zum Leben erweckt. Die lebende Rüstung verneigt sich vor dem verblüfften Bären.

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge
programme.desc: Die Lemminge haben einen Riesenspaß dabei, die Gemälde im Schloss neu zu gestalten, indem sie sich selbst neben den abgebildeten Adeligen malen. Aber Grizzy will sich selbst auf das nächste Gemälde malen und klaut das Kunstwerk zusammen mit dem Malzeug der Nager. Die wütenden Lemminge sind entschlossen, ihr Material um jeden Preis zurückzuholen. Es ist der Beginn eines Streits, den man als... künstlerisch bezeichnen könnte!

programme.title: Die Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Als Max von Phoebes Zusammenarbeit mit Captain Perfect erfährt, ist er entschlossen, das Geheimnis des neuen Superhelden aufzudecken. Chloes Schwarm BC lädt sie zu einer Produktparty ein, vor der Jinx und Booch protestieren.

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: Mats und Malika treffen auf einen Flaschengeist, der keine Lust mehr auf sein Leben in der Flasche hat. Und so findet sich Mats unversehens als neuer Flaschengeist wieder, was auch ihm so gar nicht gefällt.

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: Malika hat sich in der Bibliothek ein Buch über ein Mädchen in der afrikanischen Savanne ausgeliehen. Wie durch Zauberhand werden Malika und Mats in das Buch gezogen und befinden sich mitten in der Geschichte.

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: Mats und Malika wollen heute mit der Klasse ins Museum. Einmal im Leben sind sie zu früh dran. Das Museum ist noch geschlossen. Mats entdeckt eine offene Seitentür zum Museum, nichts ahnend, dass sie von zwei Dieben aufgebrochen wurde.

programme.title: Weihnachtsmann And Co. KG
programme.desc: Grantelbart klaut die Formel für das Zauberpuder, stellt es selbst her und erweckt damit alles Spielzeug zum Leben. So kann der Weihnachtsmann die Spielsachen nicht den Kindern bringen.

programme.title: Weihnachtsmann And Co. KG
programme.desc: Sebastian ist ein kleiner unentschlossener Junge, der jeden Tag seinen Wunschzettel ändert. Deshalb stapeln sich schon Dutzende von unnützen Geschenken in der Spielzeugfabrik. Um Sebastians Unentschlossenheit ein Ende zu bereiten, sucht ihn der Weihnachtsmann höchstpersönlich auf - doch das hätte er lieber bleiben lassen sollen.

programme.title: Unicorn Academy
programme.desc: Das Saphir-Team bemüht sich intensiv darum, den Konflikt zwischen Sophia und Ava zu lösen. Doch während sie sich mit dieser Herausforderung auseinandersetzen, taucht ein noch größeres Problem auf: Ein skrupelloses Duo hat es auf das Dunkelherz abgesehen und stellt somit eine ernsthafte Bedrohung dar.

programme.title: Witch Detectives
programme.desc: Ein mysteriöser USB-Stick, den Millie im Museum erhält, löst beim Anschließen an ihren Laptop einen gefährlichen Virus in der gesamten Stadt aus. Kommissar Andrew fordert ihre sofortige Festnahme, doch Direktor Allistair setzt ein Verhör durch. Während die Hexen fieberhaft nach dem wahren Verantwortlichen suchen, stellt sich die Frage, welche Rolle die plötzlich verschwundene Mutter von Wendys Freund Hernan bei diesem Vorfall spielt.

programme.title: Wild Kat
programme.desc: Die beliebte Sängerin Giovanna Piera wird plötzlich bei einem Liveauftritt von einem Werwesen angegriffen. Jetzt sind Kat, Idris und Giovannas größter Fan Dimitri gefragt. Sie müssen das Werwesen bis zu Giovannas nächsten Auftritt ausfindig machen, um einen weiteren Angriff zu verhindern.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizonte: Die Serie
programme.desc: Liko wird bei einem Trainingsunfall verletzt und Felori fühlt sich schuldig und flieht von der Tapferen Oliviana. Liko findet Unterschlupf bei Marnia, einer Schnurr-Pokémon-Züchterin, die sich um Felori gekümmert hat. Dort erfährt Liko alles über Feloris Vergangenheit und seine besonderen Fähigkeiten. Mit diesem Wissen ermutigt Liko Felori zum Kampf gegen ein Spinsidias. Ob ihre Freundschaft diesen Test überstehen wird, bleibt abzuwarten.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: Submarine Jim
programme.desc: Jim möchte bei der großen Seeigel-Vertreterwahl glänzen und schlüpft dafür in die Rolle von Käpt'n Nett. Durch seine übertriebene Freundlichkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft lassen sich die Seeigel jedoch schnell zu frechen Streichen und Regelverstößen hinreißen. Jim erkennt, dass er als Anführer klare Grenzen setzen muss. Bianca zeigt den Seeigeln schließlich, wie sie ihre Probleme eigenständig lösen, während Jim seine Rolle als Käpt'n überdenkt.

programme.title: Submarine Jim
programme.desc: Käpt'n Jim beauftragt Team Meeresblau, bestehend aus vier Sardinen, mit einer Mission, doch der Funkkontakt reißt ab. Jim startet eine übermotivierte Rettungsaktion, die ihn zu flatternden Flatterfischen und einer klebrigen Falle führt. Zwischen Zuckerchaos und überraschenden Zeitschriften-Tipps beweisen Mut und Teamgeist ihre Stärke. Am Ende gelingt es, das Team zu retten und alle sicher zurückzubringen.

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: Mats und Malika kommen wirklich jeden Morgen zu spät zur Schule - aber nicht weil sie verschlafen oder den Bus verpasst haben. Das wäre ja viel zu gewöhnlich! Stattdessen erleben sie schon vor dem Schulklingeln die größten Abenteuer.

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: Auf dem Schulweg finden Mats und Malika einen sprechenden Kuscheltier-Hasen, der Thorsten gehört. Als sie ihn ihm zurückgeben wollen, streitet Thorsten das ab, denn er sei ja kein Baby mehr. Doch Mats und Malika helfen den beiden, wieder zueinander zu finden.

programme.title: Sändningsuppehåll
programme.desc: Vi saknar beskrivning för denna sändning.

programme.title: Sveriges nästa stjärnkock - New York
programme.desc: Det har blivit dags för årets överlägset mest hektiska kväll på New Yorks restauranger - alla hjärtans dag. Både Barbuto och Aska är fullbokade, och nu måste kockarna visa att de klarar pressen när allt ställs på sin spets. Frank konfronteras med ett grovt misstag från en tidigare kväll, medan Astrid anländer till Aska i kläder som bryter mot klädkoden. Nu måste köksmästare Fredrik fatta ett avgörande beslut: får hon stanna och köra service - eller skickas hon hem?

programme.title: Hövdingen - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Stammen flyr till Finland och slår läger norr om Polcirkeln. Temperaturen kryper ner mot 40 minusgrader och det är mörkt. Att hitta mat är svårt i snön och gruppen isoleras ännu mer från omvärlden. Plötsligt försvinner ett barn i skogen.

programme.title: Trion
programme.desc: Thora väntar på Hugo, medan tystnaden fylls av minnen från deras ungdom.

programme.title: Fråga doktorn - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Cathrine Pedersen och Lennart Carlsson fick diagnosen KOL för många år sedan och berättar hur det är att leva med sjukdomen. Tillsammans med professor Karin Wadell går Jens Persson och Linda Olofsson igenom rökning, medicinering, motion och övningar.

programme.title: Min ångest och jag - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Kön och trans. Tänk att födas i en kropp som inte stämmer överens med den man är. Varför möts transpersoner av så starka reaktioner? Hur går det till när man ändrar kön - och vad händer om man ångrar sig? Assia träffar Loui Sand som berättar om sin resa från att födas som Louise, till att idag leva som killen han alltid vetat att han är.

programme.title: Spelet - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Sju spelare vaknar i Sviten, men endast fem kommer att gå och lägga sig när Spelets näst sista dag är över. De som klarar sig genom dagen säkrar en finalplats. Speldjävulen slår till slut klorna i en spelare som hittills varit neutral. programme.title: Pippi Långstrump
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Pippi flyttar in i Villa VillekullaSom vanligt när Tommy och Annika är på väg hem från skolan, går de förbi Villa Villekulla. Och som vanligt säger de "Tänk om det kunde flytta in någon där, någon som hade barn". Då ser de plötsligt någon röra sig därinne - en gullig liten apa! På verandan står en prickig häst, och inne i huset ligger det någon och sover med fötterna på huvudkudden. Från den dagen blir inget sig likt för Tommy och Annika. Regi: Olle Hellbom. I huvudrollerna: Inger Nilsson, Maria Persson och Pär Sundberg.

programme.title: Biet Maya
programme.desc: S1 E70 — Sa jag verkligen så?Maya är inte som alla andra bin - hon bor nämligen inte i en kupa. Ängen är hennes hem och platsen där hon upplever alla sina äventyr med sina ovanliga vänner - och sin bästis Villy, som trots att han också är ett bi egentligen är en riktig latmask.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: S2 E3 — ElefantungeVarhelst skurkar försöker stjäla åt sig ett djur någonstans i världen finns våra fyra superhjältar med högteknologiska hjälpredor där för att rädda dem!

programme.title: Ainos escape room (teckenspråk)
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Geografiprovet - Kartpussel & Egyptens skatter avslöjar kodI Geografiprovet måste eleverna använda rätt longitud och latitud för att hitta Ainos kod, utan rätt hemliga ord låser de inte upp escape-roomet.

programme.title: Nallen drömmer (teckenspråk)
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Vardag – Lika och olikaAlicia och nallen ska gå ut, men Alicia hittar bara sin ena strumpa. Hon vill hitta den andra som ser likadan ut. Nalle leker med sin klosslåda, men det är svårt att lägga rätt kloss i rätt hål. Kan nallen hjälpa Alicia att hitta sin andra strumpa? Kan Alicia hjälpa nallen så alla klossarna hamnar rätt i klosslådan?

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld
programme.desc: S2 E7 — SkallenAnimerad serie, fylld av udda personligheter. Gumball är en katt som ofta hamnar i svårigheter tillsammans med sin bäste vän och adoptivbror, den fd guldfisken Darwin. Hans lillasyster Anais är en kanin och ett geni. Skolkamraterna är av blandat slag: exempelvis en jordnöt, en banan och en T-Rex. Familjen är mycket modern, mamma går till jobbet medan pappa sköter marktjänsten.

programme.title: Den ostoppbara gula yetin
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Tallkådflods-dagenKan det bli knasigare än att flytta till en helt ny stad där det alltid är vinter och det dessutom finns en gul yeti?\nJodå - mycket knasigare!

programme.title: Piratöarna
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Den andra bonuskraftenTre syskon skannas av misstag in i ett dataspel. Där dras de in i ett äventyr fyllt av pirater och skeppsbrutna barn på jakt efter en gömd skatt. Piraterna tror att de märkliga främlingarna kommit för att lägga beslag på skatten och planerar att stoppa dem till varje pris. Kanske är den gömda skatten vägen hem, i så fall måste de hinna före piraterna. Svenska röster: Linn Ehrner, Ima Nilsson, Alexander Kaunitz, Dominique Pålsson Wiklund, Tom Ljungman, Björn Bengtsson, Allan Svensson m.fl.

programme.title: Mustangs FC
programme.desc: S2 E4 — SjälvförtroendeNy säsong med nya utmaningar. Marnie siktar högt och vill komma med i regionlaget men Mustangs behöver nya spelare för att kunna försvara sin ställning. Hur ska det gå för dem utan Ruby? Alla famlar på nya positioner. Säsong 2.

programme.title: Pepparkornen
programme.desc: S13 E9 — Den falska hyresvärdenRövare och gangsters, tjuvar och banditer. Passa er, här kommer vi och sätter alla bovar bakom galler!

programme.title: Tidlös prinsessa
programme.desc: S2 E4 — Vad som än krävsNär vi sist träffade gänget var Lena kvar i vår tid och Thea fast i historisk tid. Vad ska hända nu? Vem ska hem eller tillbaka och vad är ens hem eller tillbaka? En sak är säker, livet blir inte som någon, vare sig de eller du, kunde tro.

programme.title: Teds topp 10
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Tio sätt att misslyckas med en fysikuppgiftKonstiga vänner? Skilda föräldrar? Ingen chokladtårta? Inga problem, med Ted topp tio-listor hanterar du allt livet kan kasta på dig. Typ.

programme.title: Viljas äventyr
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Kometen ViljaVilja hjälper en vetenskapsfantast till toppen av ett berg.

programme.title: Supermuntra magiska skogen
programme.desc: S1 E25 — SkogsinspektionenFem tappra hjältar ger sig ut på episka äventyr för att besegra skurkar och lösa kluriga gåtor.

programme.title: Ett fall för KLURO
programme.desc: S1 E27 — Harry-galanHar din bil någon gång börjat dansa, har ditt hus förvandlats till en rymdraket eller har siffrorna i din mattebok försvunnit spårlöst? Agenterna på KLURO löser problemen.

programme.title: Full fart, familjen!
programme.desc: S2 E16 — SkuldjaktenTre tokigt unika familjer delar livets kärlek, kaos, triumfer och utbrott i berättelser deras fantastiska barns perspektiv!

programme.title: Storslaget, Steffi!
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Bebis-trädgårdenKreativitet är alltid bättre när man är flera! Steffi har visserligen bra idéer men fantasi-gänget behövs för att det ska bli storslaget. I det här fallet...

programme.title: Charlie och Lola
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Jag kommer att vara extra jätteförsiktigCharlie hänger ofta ute med sin kompis Marv. Han gillar fotboll, raketer och att hitta på historier. Han gillar också sin lillasyster Lola. Det är bara en sak - hon är väldigt bestämd och envis. Svenska röster: Jakob Bergström, Ella Andersson, Mathilda Smedius, Benjamin Wahlgren m.fl.

programme.title: Greta Gris
programme.desc: S7 E18 — Babbel-fiaGreta är en glatt grymtande liten gris som bor med mamma Gris, pappa Gris och lillebror Georg. Greta tycker om att spela spel, leka och klä ut sig men det absolut bästa hon vet är att hoppa i lerpölar.

programme.title: Fåret Shaun
programme.desc: S2 E16 — Everything Must GoNär bonden inte ser på blir djuren sina riktiga jag. Detta avsnitt: Allting går att sälja.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: S3 E40 — RosenMolang är en glad och energisk kanin vars bästa vän är kycklingen Piu Piu.

programme.title: Tripp, Trapp, Träd
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Vassa tänderVassa tänder. Idag hittar Tripp och Trapp såpbubblor som de tar sig över sjön med. I biografen visas en film om Lilja som ska träna brasiliansk jiu-jitsu. Bokfågeln berättar godnattsagan "Vit haj".

Men er maden er værd at blive siddende for? Og Helles arbejdsgiver har passiviseret alle omkring hende, så det nu er hende alene, der står med alt ansvaret. Spørgsmålet er, hvor længe hun kan holde til det?

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: I Malling ved Århus Bor Camilla og Michael med deres to små børn. Parrets gæld er løbet løbsk og nu håber de, at eksperterne kan hjælpe dem. Men med en massiv offentlig gæld fra blandt andet ubetalt børnebidrag til Michaels børn fra et tidligere forhold, er det en nærmest umulig opgave. Hvis Camilla og Michael skal have råd til blot at betale de almindelige udgifter til husholdningen, skal de skrue gevaldigt ned for forbruget til dem selv og indse, at tingene slet ikke er, som de selv tror.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen Jul
programme.desc: Juleforberedelserne er godt i gang, og familien kaster sig ud i nye projekter; men ikke alt går som forventet. Heldigvis har Linse et meget uventet stykke værktøj liggende i bilen, som kan redde dagen.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: I Seabrook, North Carolina i 1940'erne tilbringer den unge overklassepige Allie Hamilton (Rachel McAdams) og den lokale knægt Noah Calhoun (Ryan Gosling) en lidenskabelig og sorgløs sommer sammen og forelsker sig hovedløst. Men da sommeren går på hæld, adskilles det unge par af krigen og pligten. I nutiden besøger en ældre herre (James Garner) et plejehjem, hvor han læser højt af sin notesbog for en kvinde (Gena Rowlands), der er ved at miste sine minder. Mens han fortæller historien om to unge elskende, der har livet foran sig, genlever hans elskede Allie en gammel lidenskab, der aldrig døde, og det ubrydelige bånd mellem to almindelige mennesker, der ophøjes af den ægte kærligheds styrke, kraft og skønhed.

programme.title: Canary Black
programme.desc: CIA-agenten Avery Graves (Kate Beckinsale) påtager sig en vigtig mission i Tokyo, hvor hun infiltrerer en sikret bygning for at stjæle et vigtigt drev fra en våbenhandler. Efter et anspændt opgør får hun fat i drevet og vender hjem til Zagreb i Kroatien, hvor hun lever et tilsyneladende normalt liv med sin mand. Men hendes verden bliver vendt på hovedet, da han bliver kidnappet, og hun modtager et kryptisk opkald, der kræver, at hun stjæler en fil fra et højsikret CIA-anlæg til gengæld for, at han kommer sikkert tilbage. Desperat efter at redde sin mand dykker Avery ned i spionagens mørke underverden og afdækker en sammensværgelse, der er knyttet til en mystisk fil ved navn »Canary Black«. Mens hun navigerer gennem forræderi, dødbringende fælder og intense konfrontationer, opdager Avery, at Canary Black har potentielt skadelige globale konsekvenser.

programme.title: The Irrational

Janni har en plan om at overraske sin 25 år ældre mand, milliardæren Karsten Ree, med en romantisk indsprøjtning i deres forhold. programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Cathrine og Kent på 32 år bor med deres to døtre på 3 og 6 år i Løjt Kirkeby i Sønderjylland. Hun arbejder som pædagog i en naturbørnehave, og han har tidligere haft sin egen tøjbutik, men er nu uden arbejde. Familiens økonomi er tynget af den gæld Kent har fra sit tidligere firma.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Marianne på 37 bor i Edinburgh i Skotland. I 2004 tog hun sin drømmeuddannelse som pilot. Hun finansierede selv uddannelsen på over 800.000 kroner, men hendes far måtte kautionere for de 300.000 kr. og banken tog pant i familiens kolonihavehus for 450.000.

programme.desc: Der sker et par forandringer på Bryggen. Men inden da skal det nye tøj lige prøves af, så Linse inviterer Mor Ann forbi til at gå catwalk og lege fotomodel i hendes stue.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Der er fart over feltet på Bryggen. Stephanie er tæt på at være færdig med at tage sit kørekort. Så hendes kørelærer tager hende med ud på hendes forhåbentlig sidste køretime, som bliver mere dramatisk end først forventet.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Tina, Amalie og Janni besøger Gunnvør for at se hendes lille nyfødte dreng, som hun har fået med modellen Oliver Bjerrehus.
